about: What the contracts cannot state about an operation's tables, one entry per operation, each with its reason. tools/derive-lineage.py adds `reads`/`writes` to what the contract derives and takes `notReads`/`notWrites` away. Authored by hand: nothing in the refresh writes it. An entry marked `carried` was copied from the hand-kept lineage when it became derived (20 October 2026, CHG-R8GEN-001); their number may only fall (carriedCeiling, check-lineage LN-OVERRIDE). To change an operation's tables, change its contract (a persisted schema, x-ticvai-read-via, x-ticvai-write-via, x-ticvai-config-change-log); add an override only for what no contract fact can say, with a reason, and without `carried`.
